description: Source code for account voucher management in an OpenERP/Odoo module, defining classes for vouchers and voucher lines with methods for processing accounting entries.

classes.name: ir_sequence_type
classes.description: Model for sequence types, inheriting from osv.osv with name and code fields.

classes.name: account_voucher
classes.description: Main model for accounting vouchers, including methods for voucher processing, move creation, and state management.

classes.name: VoucherLine
classes.description: Model for voucher lines, representing individual accounting entries within a voucher.

methods.name: _get_type
methods.description: Determine the voucher type from context.

methods.name: _get_journal
methods.description: Select journal based on voucher type.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Get user's company currency or default.

methods.name: open_voucher
methods.description: Validate total amount and set voucher to proforma state.

methods.name: proforma_voucher
methods.description: Finalize voucher, generate number, create move lines, and set to posted.

methods.name: cancel_voucher
methods.description: Cancel voucher and delete associated move.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Delete vouchers if in draft or canceled state.

methods.name: _get_analytic_lines
methods.description: Generate analytic lines for voucher lines.

methods.name: action_move_line_create
methods.description: Create accounting move and move lines for the voucher.

methods.name: line_get_convert
methods.description: Convert voucher line data into move line format.

methods.name: _convert_ref
methods.description: Format reference string by removing slashes.

methods.name: action_number
methods.description: Assign sequence number to voucher and update references.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Display name for voucher based on type and number.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Search vouchers by number or name.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicate voucher with default values reset.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancel associated move and set voucher state to cancel.
